title: Parcel desk: give the working queue room
summary: A complete fictional operations workspace, repaired under one fixed contract. Charts, shipment identities, filters, disclosures, and detail tabs are preserved.

callouts.title: Bound the framing
callouts.interpretation: At desktop widths, the shorter heading returns vertical space to the task. Whether this is enough emphasis for the operator remains a design judgment.

callouts.title: Give peers common anchors
callouts.interpretation: In the desktop row, the three equal-priority carrier panels share a heading line, spacing rhythm, and footprint. Equal geometry does not establish truthful chart encoding or equal semantic importance.

callouts.title: Keep the investigation together
callouts.interpretation: At desktop widths, shorter shipment rows put more of the queue near the selected parcel. The mobile presentation is unchanged; overall task effectiveness still needs human review.
